Ruth: noticed a burst of tiny-infer pod Pending -> Preempted in us-west3a at 03:40. latency alerts from customer-facing endpoints.
Diego: any attach errors in events?
Ruth: lots of `FailedAttach` + `Preempted`. warm-node pool in the AZ dropped from ~110 -> 26 in 18m. weirdly, nvlink usage is high on only 3 racks.
Kemi: that's oddwe just enabled thermal-taint eviction on those racks yesterday to avoid overheating. could be causing hop-back placements: long-seq jobs pushed onto the few nvlink racks that still had capacity, then small jobs bounced.
infra-bot: ALERT: us-west3a warm-node depletion at 8532110012. impacted pods: 81 small-gpu pods. preemptions: 158.
Diego: so two interacting factors: (1) thermal taints removed some nodes from general pool, (2) packer prioritized nvlink nodes for long-seq throughput. result: hot racks + fragmentation.
Kemi: quick mitigation options: 1) relax thermal-taint threshold temporarily (fast), 2) add small-pod soft anti-affinity to spread, 3) bump warm-node min to recover capacity.
Ruth: netops note: r10-r12 show elevated conntrack and attach latency after the taint cycles. NetOps can we rotate those racks?
NetOps: starting rack rotation for r11 now, ETA ~25m. conntrack queues elevated due to prior drain.
Diego: I'll push an admission mutator to tag tiny pods with `placement.hint:latency` so scheduler prefers warm nodes and avoids nvlink-only racks. quick patch: `if gpu==1 and seq_len<600 -> label placement.hint=latency`.
Kemi: I'll temporarily lower thermal eviction aggressiveness for us-west3a by patching the node evaporation controller: `kubectl -n infra patch daemonset thermal-evict -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"evict","env":[{"name":"TEMP_THRESHOLD","value":"88"}]}]}}}}'`
Ruth: infra, can you bump warm-node min to 140 for the AZ? current baseline was 120.
Diego: mutator applied at 8532110105. infra patching warm-node: `kubectl -n infra patch warmnode us-west3a -p '{"spec":{"minSize":140}}'`
infra-bot: ACTION: placement mutator live at 8532110110. warmnode.minSize update recorded at 8532110120.
Kemi: early telemetry: pending queue dropping, small pods getting scheduled onto warm nodes again. nvlink node pressure easing.
NetOps: rotated r11, conntrack backlog clearing. attach latencies trending back to normal.
SRE Oncall: follow-ups: 1) add metric `per-rack thermal/seq_skew` 2) make thermal-taint interaction with packer explicit: don't pack >50% long-seq on racks flagged for thermal eviction 3) add admission mutator as a standard for latency-sensitive tiny pods 4) consider simulated packer tests that model taints.
Diego: opening PR to add `placement.hint` to scheduler preferences and a packer cap for taint-flagged racks: github.com/redwood/scheduler/pull/2024
Ruth: filing incident ticket with traces and attach logs. also adding runbook step: when warm-node < 30% baseline, bump to baseline+20% and consider reducing eviction aggressiveness.
infra-bot: RESOLVED: warm-node pool recovered at 8532110285. preempt rate returned to baseline by 8532110300.
Kemi: thanks all. we'll coordinate the packer change and thermal controller tuning in next ops sync.
